storyPoints.title: Běžné zásobování
storyPoints.description: Leden a únor: dodavatel SUP-001 dodává s obvyklou nízkou pravděpodobností zpoždění, sklad pokrývá poptávku a stížnosti i storna jsou vzácné.

storyPoints.title: Dodavatel začíná zpožďovat dodávky
storyPoints.description: Od března dodavatel SUP-001 výrazně častěji a na delší dobu zpožďuje dodávky. Zásoby jeho produktů klesají, přibývá nevyřízených objednávek, z nich vznikají stížnosti a část zákazníků objednávku zruší při nezměněných pravděpodobnostech.

expectations.description: Podíl zpožděných dodávek dodavatele SUP-001 po březnu vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, AVG(CASE WHEN is_delayed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value FROM main.supplier_delivery WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Počet nevyřízených objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d, CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1, 2), cnt AS (SELECT CAST(b.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.order_backorder b JOIN main.product p ON p.id = b.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(cnt.n), 0) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.d = days.d GROUP BY days.period

expectations.description: Počet stížností za den na objednávky produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d, CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1, 2), cnt AS (SELECT CAST(c.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.complaint c JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = c.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(cnt.n), 0) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.d = days.d GROUP BY days.period

expectations.description: Počet stornovaných objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) AS d, CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1, 2), cnt AS (SELECT CAST(x.date AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.order_cancellation x JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = x.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.period AS period, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(cnt.n), 0) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM days LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.d = days.d GROUP BY days.period

expectations.description: Kontrola: počet objednávek za den na produkty nedotčeného dodavatele SUP-002 (poptávka) zůstane stabilní.
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(o.date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(o.date AS DATE)) AS value FROM main.customer_order o JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Kontrola: celková poptávka (počet objednávek za den) zůstane stabilní.
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2024-03-01' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE)) AS value FROM main.customer_order GROUP BY 1
